I'm constantly updating my [birding megapost](personal/nd_birding/index.qmd). 

See what I'm reading and watching recently [here](personal/nd_personal_library/index.qmd).

```{r, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(here)

# load
df <- read_csv(here("personal", "nd_personal_library", "lib_df.csv"))
lib <- read_csv(here("personal", "nd_personal_library", "lib_df.csv"))
gig <- read_csv(here("personal", "nd_personal_library", "gig_df.csv"))

# book
lib_book <- lib %>%
  filter(type == "book") %>%
  mutate(name = str_replace(name, "\\[(.*?)\\]\\(.*?\\)", "\\1"))

last_book <- lib_book %>%
  slice_tail(n = 1)

# movie
lib_mov <- lib %>%
  filter(type == "movie") %>%
  mutate(name = str_replace(name, "\\[(.*?)\\]\\(.*?\\)", "\\1"))

last_mov <- lib_mov %>%
  slice_tail(n = 1)

gig <- gig %>%
  mutate(tour = str_replace(tour, "\\[(.*?)\\]\\(.*?\\)", "\\1"))

last_gig <- gig %>%
  slice_tail(n = 1)
```

- Recently watched: *`{r} last_mov[1,3]` *by *`{r} last_mov[1,4]` *on `{r} last_mov[1,1]`

- Recently read: *`{r} last_book[1,3]` *by *`{r} last_book[1,4]` *on `{r} last_book[1,1]`

- Recently attended: *`{r} last_gig[1,2]` *by *`{r} last_gig[1,3]` *on `{r} last_gig[1,1]`

```{=html}
<script>NekoType="kina"</script>
<h1 id=nl><script src="https://webneko.net/n20171213.js"></script><a 
href="https://webneko.net">Neko</a></h1>

<script>
document.getElementById('random-post-btn').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const btn = this;
    const originalText = btn.innerHTML;
    
    btn.innerHTML = 'Picking...';
    btn.style.pointerEvents = 'none';

    fetch('search.json')
        .then(response => {
            if (!response.ok) throw new Error('File not found');
            return response.json();
        })
        .then(data => {
            const posts = data.filter(item => 
                item.href && 
                (item.href.includes('personal/') || item.href.includes('work/')) && 
                !item.href.includes('#')
            );

            if (posts.length > 0) {
                const randomIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * posts.length);
                let targetRelativePath = posts[randomIndex].href;

                const basePath = window.location.pathname.replace(/\/[^\/]*$/, '/');
                
                window.location.href = window.location.origin + basePath + targetRelativePath;
            } else {
                alert('No posts found!');
                btn.innerHTML = originalText;
                btn.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
            }
        })
        .catch(error => {
            console.error('Error:', error);
            alert('Oops! Could not load the blog index.');
            btn.innerHTML = originalText;
            btn.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
        });
});
</script>
```
